title: Single-axis high-energy X-ray diffraction tomography for elastic residual strain: uniqueness and stability of solutions in the presence of equilibrium constraints
summary: It is well-established that single-axis Transverse Ray Transform tomography data from high-energy X-ray diffraction is insufficient for general reconstruction of three-dimensional elastic strain. In this paper we show that, when combined with the constraint of mechanical equilibrium, this problem becomes uniquely solvable for isotropic elastic samples with known elastic constants and non-zero Poisson's ratio.
